# Frontend Control Center | AI-Powered Smart Irrigation System

A real-time, responsive web interface for monitoring telemetry, inspecting AI-driven irrigation decisions, and executing manual hardware overrides on the ESP32 node.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

* **Real-Time Telemetry Dashboard:** Displays field metrics including soil moisture percentage, field temperature, relative humidity, rain probability, and expected rainfall volume.
* **AI Decision Engine Banner:** Displays live status predictions (`Pump ON` / `Pump OFF`) generated by the Random Forest model along with crop and soil metadata.
* **3-Second Asynchronous Polling:** Built using raw JavaScript `Fetch API` to poll the Flask server every 3000ms for zero-latency state synchronization without page reloads.
* **Manual Hardware Override:** Dedicated interface triggers allowing users to bypass AI automation (`Force Pump ON`, `Force Pump OFF`) or restore control (`Return to Auto ML`).
* **Connection Status Indicator:** Visual status badge reflecting backend server health (`Connected` vs. `Disconnected`) with real-time feedback.
* **Browser Push Notifications:** Requests permission to push system state alerts for critical field updates and override events.

---

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

| Technology | Role | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **HTML5** | Application structure & semantic layout | Native |
| **Tailwind CSS** | Utility-first styling & dark mode UI design | CDN (`cdn.tailwindcss.com`) |
| **Font Awesome 6.4.0** | Iconography for sensors, controls, and status badges | CDN (`cdnjs.cloudflare.com`) |
| **Google Fonts (Inter)** | Dashboard typography | CDN (`fonts.googleapis.com`) |
| **JavaScript (ES6+)** | Asynchronous polling logic & API payload handling | Native |
